title: Rekonstruktion U-Bhf. "Spittelmarkt" Nebenträume - Ausgang Spittelmarkt, TP: Sanitäre Installation (Grundriß)
main_content: Floor plan (scale 1:50) of the sanitary installation in the auxiliary rooms and the Spittelmarkt exit of the Spittelmarkt underground station. It shows the spatial layout of the rooms relative to platform tracks 1 and 2, with the exit direction marked, and the routing of the technical piping: cold water lines, natural gas (Erdgas) line, wastewater (sewage) lines, and insulated pipes, including a washing table with mirror and shelf, drain pipes NW60 with hatches, and a note to coordinate with the electrical trade before installation begins.
